# Science Publishing Group

> An international academic publisher offering peer-reviewed journals, special issues, and conference proceedings across multidisciplinary scientific fields.

SciencePG provides a comprehensive platform for researchers to publish and discover open-access scholarly content across life sciences, medicine, mathematics, physics, chemistry, engineering, computer science, and social sciences. The platform supports both individual journal submissions and conference-based publications through a rigorous peer-review process.

## Key Topics

- academic publishing
- peer-reviewed journals

## Journal Directory & Browse

- [Journals List - Browse by Subject](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject): Main journals directory for browsing SciencePG's multidisciplinary journal catalog
- [Life Sciences, Agriculture & Food Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/11): Life Sciences, Agriculture & Food journals: Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Immunology
- [Medicine & Health Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/15): Medicine & Health journals: Psychiatry, Cancer Research, Biomedical Sciences
- [Mathematics & Physics Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/12): Mathematics & Physics journals: Modern Physics, High Energy Physics, Biophysics
- [Computer Science & AI Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/23): Computer Science & AI journals: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Mining
- [Chemistry Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/70): Chemistry journals: Physical Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Energy & Chemical
- [Materials Science Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/51): Materials Science journals: Photonic Materials, Mineral Processing, Metallurgy
- [Architecture & Engineering Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/60): Architecture & Engineering journals: Civil Engineering, Transportation, Urban Planning
- [Earth, Energy & Environment Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/16): Earth, Energy & Environment journals: Remote Sensing, Environmental Protection
- [Economics & Management Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/17): Economics & Management journals: Finance, Accounting, Operations Management
- [Multidisciplinary Science Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/18): Multidisciplinary Science journals: Engineering, Applied Sciences, Research
- [Humanities & Social Sciences Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/20): Humanities & Social Sciences journals: Art, Design, Psychology, HR Management
- [Education Journals](http://sciencepg.org/journals/browse-by-subject/19): Education journals: Sports Science, Elementary & Secondary Education

## Special Issues & Call for Papers

- [Ongoing Special Issues](http://sciencepg.org/special-issues/ongoing): Ongoing special issues with call for papers and submission deadlines
- [Published Special Issues](http://sciencepg.org/special-issues/published): Published special issues archive across life sciences, food, and ecology
- [Special Issue Guidelines](http://sciencepg.org/special-issues/guidelines): Guidelines for submitting articles to SciencePG special issue collections
- [Propose a Special Issue](http://sciencepg.org/special-issues/propose): Process for proposing new special issues and guest editor guidelines
